infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: EVRoute uses the camera so you can attach a photo of your charger when you list it.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: EVRoute lets you pick a photo of your charger from your library.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: EVRoute uses your location to show chargers near you and to place your own charger on the map.
